core.title: Simple Solid Black Lever, Acorn SCGBI

text.description_html:
Acorn SCGBI, Simple Solid Black Leverset

This Acorn made lever is beautiful in its simplicity. It is a popular choice for design experts because it will blend in with almost any decor: traditional, contemporary, old world, or chic. Its ability to transition from one decor to another means that it could look good in every room of your house; and even if the room's decor changes, you won't have to change the lever to match. Made by Acorn, the Simple Solid Black Lever will fit standard pre-drilled doors with either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backsets with door thicknesses of 1-3/4" or a 1-3/8". Available in single dummy, passage, privacy, and keyed entry functions.

Features of the Simple Solid Black Lever:

  • Fits standard pre-drilled doors with 2-1/8" crossbores and 15/16" edgebores.
  • Complete with rose and reversible tubular latch.
  • The cylinder of the Keyed Entry Function is solid brass with a 5 pin tumbler and nickel pins.
  • Keyed Entry Function has a Schlage Type keyway.

Specifications of the Simple Solid Black Iron Lever:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" or 1-3/8"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: A stationary lever for use as a pull or to match trim on one side of door. Complete set - 1 lever, 1 rose, and mounting screws.
  • Passage Set (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
  • Privacy Set (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior lever engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior lever. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
  • Keyed Entry (keyed lock): Use when a lock operated by a key is needed. Unlocked by key from the outside. From the inside, the deadlatch is thrown and retracted by a turn button in the center of the lever. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, mounting screws, and key.

Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!
